verdict.rationale: Honcho's own docs say developers can shape retrieval with search, token budgets, summaries, and peer scoping. That is a first-party way to steer recall beyond one fixed query, but the only filter-like control is peer scoping, not arbitrary metadata filters. missing for 10: documented metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, reranking options, API/SDK parameter docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can steer retrieval with metadata filters, keyword/hybrid search modes, or reranking instead of accepting a single fixed similarity search
